description: This Java class defines strategies for handling connectivity commands, specifically for situations where a connection has been deleted. It includes singleton pattern implementation, strategy initialization, and handling of unrecognized commands.

classes.name: ConnectionDeletedStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that provides strategies to handle connectivity commands related to deleted connections, extending AbstractCommandStrategies for specific command and event types.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionDeletedStrategies.

methods.name: newDeletedStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new set of strategies for handling deletion scenarios.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands received for a connection that has been deleted by logging a warning and returning an error result.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Indicates that a command is always considered defined for logging purposes.

methods.name: getEmptyResult
methods.description: Provides an empty result, indicating no event was produced.
